scientific_scope: post-view structural audit, not a predictive model test: quantify whether exact-tail continuation hazards vary materially across competition domains and calendar time in already-open pre-2024 data
motivation_boundary: C075-E and C075-F failures may motivate the question only. Their target labels are not read, merged, fitted or scored in this audit.

source.name: eatpizzanot/soccer-dataset
source.identity_gate: same C071 threshold-8 strict-PIT opportunity-history eligible identities
source.label_horizon: goal labels are selected at file-read time only for date_utc < 2024-01-01

population: eligible completed pre-2024 matches with exact T>=7

hazards.h3: P(E>=3 | E>=2) = P(T>=10 | T>=9), diagnostic only

grouping.league: league_id aggregated across all pre-2024 years
grouping.calendar_year: UTC kickoff calendar year aggregated across leagues
grouping.league_year: league_id x UTC kickoff calendar year

statistics.cell_estimate: raw success/risk proportion with Wilson 90% interval
statistics.heterogeneity: continuity-corrected logit fixed-effect Cochran Q with chi-square p-value and I2=max(0,(Q-df)/Q)
statistics.global_memoryless_diagnostic: report global h1/h2/h3 only; no independence test because risk sets are nested

frozen_interpretation_rule.STRONG_DOMAIN_HETEROGENEITY: league-year h1 has >=10 eligible cells, Q p<0.01 and I2>=0.50, AND league-level h1 has >=5 eligible groups, Q p<0.05 and I2>=0.30
frozen_interpretation_rule.MODERATE_DOMAIN_HETEROGENEITY: at least one of those two h1 conditions holds but not both
frozen_interpretation_rule.h2_role: supporting/contradicting evidence only; it cannot change the frozen h1 classification

claim_boundary: This audit may reject a universal stationary tail-hazard assumption as a structural simplification, but it cannot promote a domain-conditioned model or supply q(k|T>=7) for formal use.
